definition.name: FADE-1
definition.rule: frozen resistance zone (P14 methodology unchanged); FIRST touch only (tap_no==1); fill = limit at near edge, requires >=2 ticks trade-through; stop = edge+20.0 pts; target = edge-30.0 pts; cost 1.0pt RT; one trade per zone-session; one-open-trade; all sessions; no R4, no fire/mono filters, no model
definition.provenance: P18 Stage B nested walk-forward; registered hypothesis H1; selection criterion max worst-fold on coarse grid; plateau verified; shadow-control superior in 10/10 blocks
definition.caveat: ZERO external validation; HOLDOUT A included in development; outcome model grid-approximated (production ledger pass required before any live consideration)
